water.advice: Apply 40 mm irrigation based on root-zone depletion balance for Crown Root Initiation stage.

leaves.title: What to look for this week
leaves.symptoms: Circular pinhead-sized lesions or yellow pustules on lower leaves, turning yellow and withering off early.
leaves.cultural_advice: Maintain proper air flow and regulate irrigation moisture.

feed.advice: Apply split dose of nitrogen before irrigation per local recommendations.
